'''Gaden-Ko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic in training]] at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Gaden-Ko was the son of a sculptor and a former [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] who was maimed by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] when Gaden-Ko was small. As was Voss custom, he was raised by his grandfather, [[Dajan-Ko]], who soon noticed the young Gaden-Ko's uncanny intuition. This insight allowed him to aid Voss commandos by predicting where Gormak patrols would be. Thus marked as a potential Mystic visionary, he had spent years at the [[Tower of Prophecy]], studying and preparing to go on his pilgrimage.

A [[Jedi Consular]] known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]], in search of an alliance with the Voss, decided to help Gaden-Ko in his training and found him along the [[Holy Path of Mir]], just starting his pilgrimage, but having lost all his bodyguards, and offered to protect him on his pilgrimage. Grateful for the help of the Barsen'thor, Gaden-Ko succeeded and became a Mystic and his first vision showed him that his destiny was to help his new friend and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> The [[Three]], the government of [[Voss]], lamented that though they gained a Mystic, they were now losing him to the off-worlders. Gaden-Ko assured the Three that he was not lost to them. He explained that by working with the Barsen'thor, he had seen that the Republic showed wisdom and kindness, and advocated allying Voss with them. Gaden-Ko later gained a small entourage of Voss Commandos, healers, and interpreters as he joined the Barsen'thor's crew.<ref name="Shattering">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Shattering|the ''Javelin''}}</ref> After the defeat of the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]], Gaden-Ko suggested to the Barsen'thor, Master [[Jaric Kaedan]], and [[Satele Shan]] that they could send Jedi to Voss so they could gain wisdom from one another.

==Personality and traits==
Gaden-Ko's generation was the first to grow up in a [[Voss-Ka]] where alien outsiders were a common sight. He had always had an interest in these foreigners, even developing a friendship with the Republic ambassador. Gaden-Ko was seen to be rather impulsive and impatient compared to other Voss.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I swore to the Republic I would protect them from danger. After witnessing the darkness in you, I believe you are the danger.|Gaden-Ko speaks to the dark-sided Barsen'thor|<ref name="Nathema">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref>}}
In the flashpoint "The Nathema Conspiracy", if [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] is a [[Jedi Consular]] aligned with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Gaden-Ko will seek to stop the player and join the [[Order of Zildrog]] led by [[Vinn Atrius]], only to be sacrificed as fuel to awaken [[Zildrog]] by [[GEMINI 16]] on [[Nathema]]. If the Jedi Consular remained on the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], the player will encounter [[Sophia Farash]] instead, while the other classes face antagonists from their own class stories.<ref name="Nathema" />
